description: This PHP source file defines the SsoTokenProvider class, which manages fetching, refreshing, and validating SSO tokens from AWS SSO profiles, including handling token cache files and refresh logic.

classes.name: SsoTokenProvider
classes.description: A class that provides and manages AWS SSO tokens, including loading from cache, refreshing tokens, and validating token data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SsoTokenProvider with profile name, config file path, and optional SSO OIDC client.

methods.name: resolveProfileName
methods.description: Resolves the profile name to use, prioritizing argument, environment variable, or default.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Resolves the configuration file path, defaulting to ~/.aws/config if not provided.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads cached SSO credentials asynchronously, validates, and returns an SsoToken object.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the SSO token if conditions are met, otherwise returns current token data.

methods.name: shouldAttemptRefresh
methods.description: Determines if a token refresh should be attempted based on last refresh time and expiration window.

methods.name: getTokenLocation
methods.description: Generates the file path for the cached token based on the SSO session name.

methods.name: getTokenData
methods.description: Reads and decodes token data from the cache file.

methods.name: validateTokenData
methods.description: Validates the presence and correctness of token data properties and expiration.

methods.name: writeNewTokenDataToDisk
methods.description: Writes updated token data to the cache file with proper expiration formatting.
